statement: CCDR SSP projections indicate approximately +2°C by 2055 and +3°C by 2090, with more frequent/intense extremes and worsening drought, especially late-century and in southern areas.

statement: The 2023 CCDR reports scenario-dependent city rainfall changes: about +10 mm/year in Deir el Balah, Gaza City and Khan Yunis under SSP1 but about -10 mm under SSP2/SSP3; West Bank cities may lose more than 20 mm under higher scenarios. It also reports modelled recharge sensitivity of 14-24% loss for 10% lower rainfall and 28-50% for 15% lower rainfall, and identifies sea-level rise and saltwater intrusion as additional pressures on Gaza groundwater.
compact_statement: Rainfall/recharge changes are scenario-sensitive.
scenario: CCDR future SSP1/SSP2/SSP3 discussion in its 2055/2090 projection context; no separate date is stated for the city rainfall or recharge sensitivity figures.
